summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.75. Account takeover pattern for n.guler@aegean.edu: a payroll/IBAN phishing email (phish_suspect, aegean-edu.com.tr) was delivered on 2026-10-16 06:12, and later that same evening the account authenticated via MFA from 198.51.100.15 (AS9121 TTNET, residential ISP) instead of the usual university ASN (193.140.10.52, AS-AEGEAN-EDU), followed by an OWA inbox rule moving mail to "Arşiv-2026" minutes before the portal/mail logins. This credential-phish → MFA-approved session from a non-university network → mailbox rule chain is consistent with compromise and mailbox tampering, warranting containment (password reset, MFA re-enrollment, rule removal) rather than monitor/benign. Same device_id and MFA-approved status leave residual uncertainty, but the combined signals are sufficient to treat as confirmed/suspected account takeover.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
